<main>
    <div>
        <div>
            <div>Dougs Reference Manual / The library</div>
            <h1>The Theme</h1>
            <p>A place for the library's properties, and the one styled component that dresses the framework's marks with them. Read this page to write your library's theme; the file beside it is the one the library runs.</p>
            <p><b>2-the-theme~code.tsx</b><span>19 lines</span><span>one class, $LibraryBookTheme</span><span>five fields, three parts</span><span>ink read in 14 places</span></p>
        </div>
        <div><span data-view-is="code">code</span><span data-view-is="words">words</span></div>
    </div>

    <aside data-view-is="code">
        <div><span>2-the-theme~code.tsx</span><span>where it is used</span><span><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><rect x="5" y="5" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5"/><path d="M3 10.5V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h6.5"/></svg>Copy</span></div>
        <pre><span data-n="1"><span>export class</span> <span>$LibraryBookTheme</span> <span>extends</span> <span>$Theme</span> {</span><span data-n="2">    font = <span>"'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif"</span>;</span><span data-n="3">    size = <span>'0.90625rem'</span>;</span><span data-n="4">    ink = <span>'#1a1f36'</span>;</span><span data-n="5">    paper = <span>'#ffffff'</span>;</span><span data-n="6">    accent = <span>'#0a7a70'</span>;</span><span data-n="7">    style = selection.div<span>`</span>${<span>this</span>.parts()}<span>`</span>;</span><span data-n="8"></span><span data-n="9">    <span>protected</span> parts(): <span>RuleSet</span>[] {</span><span data-n="10">        <span>return</span> [<span>this</span>.page(), <span>this</span>.writing(), <span>this</span>.links()];</span><span data-n="11">    }</span><span data-n="12"></span><span data-n="13">    <span>protected</span> page(): <span>RuleSet</span> {</span><span data-n="14">        <span>return</span> css<span>`</span></span><span data-n="15"><span>            color: </span>${({ theme }) =&gt; theme.ink}<span>;</span></span><span data-n="16"><span>            background: </span>${({ theme }) =&gt; theme.paper}<span>;</span></span><span data-n="17"><span>        `</span>;</span><span data-n="18">    }</span><span data-n="19">}</span></pre>
        <div><b>ink is read in 14 places</b>Lines 4 and 15 here, and in<span>The Book</span><span>The Frame</span><span>The Concept</span></div>
        <div><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M3 8h10M9 4l4 4-4 4"/></svg>2-the-theme~code.tsx</div>
    </aside>

    <div>
        <div>
            <h2>What it is</h2>
            <p>The framework's Theme is bare: it stands on every book and provides itself, and nothing else. So the properties are this library's own. They are declared as fields on a class under the framework's Theme, and every rule beneath reads them through the theme's own provision, as a value templated into the string.</p>
            <p>The component is one styled element, composed of parts. Each part is a method returning a fragment of rules for one thing on the page, so that a book changes one part and keeps the rest, and a reader of the file sees the look as a list of named pieces.</p>
            <h2>How it is used</h2>
            <p>Declare the fields your library reads, as many as it has. Compose the parts in the field that holds the style. Then register the theme on your book class, once, in the file that exports the class; every book of the library inherits it, and a book that wants another theme registers its own.</p>
            <pre><span>export class</span> <span>$ManualTheme</span> <span>extends</span> <span>$LibraryBookTheme</span> {
    measure = <span>'58ch'</span>;                              <span>// one value changed</span>
    <span>protected override</span> parts(): <span>RuleSet</span>[] {
        <span>return</span> [...<span>super</span>.parts(), <span>this</span>.index()];  <span>// one part added</span>
    }
}
$(Manual, Theme)(ManualTheme);                       <span>// registered on the book</span></pre>
            <p>A rule names a class the framework puts on an element, never the element itself; it reaches by descendant, never by child; and every quantity in it is one of these fields, never a literal. A face that must win over the theme on one element names the kind with its class, as the chapter on the faces says.</p>
        </div>
        <h2>Fields</h2>
        <div><b>font<small>string</small></b><span>The family every book is set in.</span></div>
        <div><b>ink<small>color</small></b><span>The color of the words. Every rule that needs it reads this field, so a book that changes it keeps the look in another ink.</span></div>
        <div><b>paper<small>color</small></b><span>The color of the page behind them.</span></div>
        <div><b>accent<small>color</small></b><span>The color of a reference to another place in the library.</span></div>
        <div>
            <h2>Before it bites</h2>
            <p>A style is compiled once per class, so a value is read through the provider's props and never through a closure over the instance. A part must not take the name of a member the class already has; the typecheck names such a thing at once, and the page breaks somewhere else if it is not run. A font declared here reaches the live page only after a bind.</p>
        </div>
        <div><a>← The Book</a><a>Initializing a Library →</a></div>
    </div>
</main>
<script>
    const page = document.documentElement;
    for (const view of document.querySelectorAll('[data-view-is]'))
        view.addEventListener('click', () => {
            page.dataset.view = view.dataset.viewIs;
            for (const other of document.querySelectorAll('.views span')) other.classList.toggle('on', other.dataset.viewIs === view.dataset.viewIs);
        });
</script>

    .me i { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--me); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1 var(--sans); font-style: normal; }
    .me b { font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

    /* under it: the book's chapters down a soft black side bar, and the page */
    .page { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: calc(100vh - 50px); }
    .holds { padding: 18px 12px; background: var(--side); color: var(--side-fg); border-right: 1px solid var(--side-line); }
    .holds h4 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 10px; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--side-dim); }
    .holds h4 small { margin-left: auto; font: 400 11.5px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }
    .holds h4.next { margin-top: 22px; }
    .holds a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 8px; }
    .holds a i { flex: none; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--me); }
    .holds a b { font-weight: 500; }
    .holds a small { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; color: var(--side-dim); }
    .holds a.on { background: var(--side-on); }
    .holds .chain { margin: 0 9px 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--side-dim); line-height: 1.4; }
    .holds .chain b { display: block; font: 600 17px/1.1 var(--frame-serif); color: var(--side-fg); margin-top: 2px; }

    .frame { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 40px 20px 96px; background: var(--ground); }

    /* the book's own tools above the sheet: the three papers */
    .controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
    .chip { padding: 7px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--chip-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--chip-fill); color: var(--chip-ink); font: 12px/1.2 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .05em; cursor: pointer; }
    .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--chip-on-ink); border-color: var(--chip-on-line); background: var(--chip-on-fill); }

    /* the sheet, as 25 */
    .pd-book { width: min(var(--sheet-width), 100%); padding: var(--sheet-pad); border: var(--sheet-border); border-radius: var(--sheet-radius); background: var(--sheet); box-shadow: var(--sheet-shadow); font-family: var(--serif); color: var(--sheet-ink); }
    .masthead { margin: 0 0 44px; text-align: center; text-indent: .32em; font: 10.5px/1.7 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .32em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--kicker); }
    .masthead::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 56px; height: 1px; margin: 16px auto 0; background: var(--kicker-rule); }
    .masthead .pa-cover, .masthead .pd-title, .masthead .pd-byline { display: inline; margin: 0; }
    .masthead .pd-byline::before { content: '·'; margin: 0 .55em 0 .25em; }
    .masthead a.to-me { padding-bottom: 3px; background: linear-gradient(var(--me), var(--me)) left bottom / calc(100% - .32em) 2px no-repeat; }
    .pd-canonical .pd-title { margin: 0 0 30px; font: 700 39px/1.15 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.01em; text-align: center; color: var(--heading); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-heading { margin: 32px 0 12px; font: 700 21px/1.15 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.01em; text-align: center; color: var(--heading); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph { margin: 0 0 18px; font-size: 17.2px; line-height: 1.8; text-align: justify; hyphens: auto; color: var(--sheet-ink); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-section:first-of-type .pd-paragraph:first-of-type::first-letter { float: left; padding: 6px 10px 0 0; font-size: 57px; line-height: .85; color: var(--initial); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph strong { font-weight: 700; color: var(--strong); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph em { font-style: italic; color: var(--emphasis); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph a { color: var(--link); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
    .turn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; grid-template-areas: "before folio after"; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px 26px; margin-top: 46px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--foot-line); font: 11px/1.5 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foot); }
    .turn b { font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: none; color: var(--foot-value); }
    .turn a { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; }
    .turn .before { grid-area: before; justify-self: start; }
    .turn .folio { grid-area: folio; }
    .turn .after { grid-area: after; justify-self: end; }

    /* a phone: the bar stays at the top, the chapters as a row of pills under it, the sheet is the screen */
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
        .lib { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 4; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; gap: 4px; overflow: auto hidden; scrollbar-width: none; }
        .logo { margin-right: 8px; }
        .logo b { font-size: 19px; }
        .find, .me b { display: none; }
        .me { position: fixed; z-index: 5; top: 0; right: 0; justify-content: center; width: 54px; height: 50px; margin: 0; }
        .page { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
        .holds { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 16px 12px; overflow: auto hidden; scrollbar-width: none; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--side-line); }
        .holds .chain, .holds h4 small { display: none; }
        .holds h4 { flex: none; margin: 0 6px 0 0; }
        .holds a { flex: none; padding: 5px 11px 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--side-line); border-radius: 99px; white-space: nowrap; }
        .holds a small { margin-left: 4px; }
        .frame { padding: 14px 0 0; }
        .controls { gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 14px; padding: 0 16px; }
        .chip { padding: 6px 12px; }
        .pd-book { flex: 1; width: 100%; padding: var(--sheet-pad-phone); border-inline: 0; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; }
        .turn { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-areas: "folio folio" "before after"; }
        .turn .folio { justify-self: center; }
    }

<script>
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const papers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-to]');
    papers.forEach(chip => chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        root.dataset.theme = chip.dataset.themeTo;
        papers.forEach(other => other.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(other === chip)));
    }));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-to]').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-chapter]').forEach(chapter => { chapter.hidden = chapter.dataset.chapter !== link.dataset.to; });
        document.querySelectorAll('.holds a').forEach(row => row.classList.toggle('on', row.dataset.to === link.dataset.to));
        scrollTo(0, 0);
    }));
</script>

The Reading View, in the Frame, with the Chapters at the Foot
×
Concept 30, an idea, after 25 under the top bar of 16, and nothing else.
The sheet of 25 integrated the other way: only the library's bar across the top, and the book navigated as 25 navigates it, by the chapters either side at the foot of the sheet, with the papers above it.

    .masthead { margin: 0 0 44px; text-align: center; text-indent: .32em; font: 10.5px/1.7 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .32em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--kicker); }
    .masthead::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 56px; height: 1px; margin: 16px auto 0; background: var(--kicker-rule); }
    .masthead .pa-cover, .masthead .pd-title, .masthead .pd-byline { display: inline; margin: 0; }
    .masthead .pd-byline::before { content: '·'; margin: 0 .55em 0 .25em; }
    .masthead a.to-me { padding-bottom: 3px; background: linear-gradient(var(--me), var(--me)) left bottom / calc(100% - .32em) 2px no-repeat; }
    .pd-canonical .pd-title { margin: 0 0 30px; font: 700 39px/1.15 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.01em; text-align: center; color: var(--heading); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-heading { margin: 32px 0 12px; font: 700 21px/1.15 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.01em; text-align: center; color: var(--heading); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph { margin: 0 0 18px; font-size: 17.2px; line-height: 1.8; text-align: justify; hyphens: auto; color: var(--sheet-ink); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-section:first-of-type .pd-paragraph:first-of-type::first-letter { float: left; padding: 6px 10px 0 0; font-size: 57px; line-height: .85; color: var(--initial); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph strong { font-weight: 700; color: var(--strong); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph em { font-style: italic; color: var(--emphasis); }
    .pd-canonical .pd-paragraph a { color: var(--link); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
    .turn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; grid-template-areas: "before folio after"; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px 26px; margin-top: 46px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--foot-line); font: 11px/1.5 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foot); }
    .turn b { font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: none; color: var(--foot-value); }
    .turn a { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; }
    .turn .before { grid-area: before; justify-self: start; }
    .turn .folio { grid-area: folio; }
    .turn .after { grid-area: after; justify-self: end; }

    /* a phone: the bar stays at the top, the chapters as a row of pills under it, the sheet is the screen */
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
        .lib { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 4; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; gap: 4px; overflow: auto hidden; scrollbar-width: none; }
        .logo { margin-right: 8px; }
        .logo b { font-size: 19px; }
        .find, .me b { display: none; }
        .me { position: fixed; z-index: 5; top: 0; right: 0; justify-content: center; width: 54px; height: 50px; margin: 0; }
        .page { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
        .holds { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 16px 12px; overflow: auto hidden; scrollbar-width: none; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--side-line); }
        .holds .chain, .holds h4 small { display: none; }
        .holds h4 { flex: none; margin: 0 6px 0 0; }
        .holds a { flex: none; padding: 5px 11px 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--side-line); border-radius: 99px; white-space: nowrap; }
        .holds a small { margin-left: 4px; }
        .frame { padding: 14px 0 0; }
        .controls { gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 14px; padding: 0 16px; }
        .chip { padding: 6px 12px; }
        .pd-book { flex: 1; width: 100%; padding: var(--sheet-pad-phone); border-inline: 0; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; }
        .turn { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-areas: "folio folio" "before after"; }
        .turn .folio { justify-self: center; }
    }
</style>
</head>

<script>
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const papers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-to]');
    papers.forEach(chip => chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        root.dataset.theme = chip.dataset.themeTo;
        papers.forEach(other => other.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(other === chip)));
    }));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-to]').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-chapter]').forEach(chapter => { chapter.hidden = chapter.dataset.chapter !== link.dataset.to; });
        document.querySelectorAll('.holds a').forEach(row => row.classList.toggle('on', row.dataset.to === link.dataset.to));
        scrollTo(0, 0);
    }));
</script>

Sketched from the Build
These were sketched on 6 October after driving what had been built, for the pains written in Driving the Build. They are drawn in the visual language of the coming-soon page rather than from its elements: mostly black, one touch at the edge of noticing, and every subtle thing with a function.
The Library's Page, in the Frame of 15
×
Concept 32, an idea, after the shelf of 1 in the frame of 15, in the language of the coming-soon page; its comparables Apple Books, Literal and Hardcover for the shelf, and Mintlify's documented side bar for the current item marked by its text alone.
The catalogue's page with every catalogue on it given a use. The top bar holds the books filed under the library and lights the open one with a hairline in its hue. The side bar holds what this book holds — its own chapter and an entry for each book filed here, each with a dot in its hue — and an entry pressed there opens on this page, under the shelf: the cover large, what the book is about, and the way in. A cover on the shelf goes to the book. The catalogue is the first book on its own shelf, in the library's own scheme, because it is the book that catalogues itself; every other cover is in its book's scheme. Under a cover, one line.
Where it is: built as the catalogue's page, its own cover first on its shelf, an entry opening in place under the shelf from its row or its cover.

The catalogue is the first book on its own shelf. An entry pressed in the side bar opens on this page; a cover goes to the book.">
<meta name="said" content="">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
    /* ---- the scheme, by role, in the language of the coming-soon page: mostly black, one touch at the threshold of noticing. ----
       ground        what the site sits on, the soft black
       words         what is read on the ground, the warm off-white, and a dimmer step of it
       hue           a book's one hue, one of the page's five orbs: warm 30, rose 340, lavender 250, sky 200, mint 160.
                     It is never painted. It is an undertone in a cover's black, a dot, and a hairline under an open name.
       paper, ink    the page a book is read on, warm, and what is read on it */
    :root {
        --ground: #0c1b1f; --words: #ffffff; --words-dim: #a9bcc1; --on-ground: rgba(255, 255, 255, .11); --ground-line: #1d3339;
        --side: #e3f5fa; --side-line: #cbe6ee; --accent: #166178;
        --paper: #faf8f5; --ink: #1d2528; --soft: #6a7378; --line: #e5e1da; --panel: #f3f0eb;
        --serif: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; --sans: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
    }
    /* every other book has a scheme of its own, made by the same method (33); on this page it shows as its cover, its dot and its hairline */
    .story, .me { --hue: 30; --c: #d9a05b; }
    .design { --hue: 224; --c: #3b6cf0; }
    .manual { --hue: 174; --c: #4fb3a8; }
    .story, .design, .manual, .me {
        --dot: var(--c);
        --hairline: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--c), transparent);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; }
    html, body { height: 100%; }
    body { display: grid; grid-template: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) / 240px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "lib lib" "holds sub" "holds thing"; overflow: hidden; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--sans); }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
    svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }
    h4 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--soft); }
    h4 small { margin-left: auto; font: 400 11.5px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }

    /* the bar across the top is the library's, on the ground. Nothing on it is painted; the open subject is lit by a hairline. */
    .lib { grid-area: lib; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; padding: 9px 18px; background: var(--ground); color: var(--words); }
    .logo { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex: none; margin-right: 12px; padding: 4px 8px 6px; border-radius: 8px; }
    .logo i { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; background: #c8f4fb; color: var(--ground); font: 600 15px/1 var(--sans); font-style: normal; }
    .logo b { font: 600 21px/1 var(--serif); white-space: nowrap; }
    .subjects { display: flex; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
    .s { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--words-dim); font-size: 13.5px; white-space: nowrap; }
    .s i { flex: none; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dot); }
    .s b { font-weight: 500; }
    .s.on, [data-at="library"] .logo { background: var(--on-ground); color: var(--words); }
    .s.on { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--c); }
    [data-at="library"] .logo { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #c8f4fb; }
    .find { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-left: auto; padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--on-ground); color: var(--words-dim); white-space: nowrap; }
    .me { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-left: 14px; color: var(--words); }
    .me i { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e8590c; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1 var(--sans); font-style: normal; }
    .me b { font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

    /* the side bar is 15's opal, and holds what this book holds: its own chapter, and an entry for each book filed here. An entry opens on this page. */
    .holds { grid-area: holds; min-width: 0; padding: 20px 12px; overflow: auto; background: var(--side); color: var(--ink); border-right: 1px solid var(--side-line); }
    .holds .chain { margin: 0 9px 16px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--soft); }
    .holds .chain b { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font: 600 17px/1.1 var(--serif); color: var(--ink); }
    .holds h4 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--soft); }
    .holds a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink); }
    .holds a i { flex: none; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dot, #4e9eb9); }
    .holds a.self i { background: var(--ground); }
    .holds a b { font-weight: 500; }
    .holds a small { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; color: var(--soft); }
    .holds a.on { background: var(--paper); color: var(--accent); }
    .holds .built { margin-top: 26px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--side-line); }
    .holds .built a { font-size: 12.5px; padding: 4px 9px; }

    /* the page's head: what it is filed under, its name, who it is by, its tools */
    .sub { grid-area: sub; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px 20px; min-width: 0; padding: 22px 32px 14px; }
    .chain { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--soft); white-space: nowrap; }
    .chain em { font: 600 9.5px/1 var(--sans); font-style: normal; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .chain a { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--line); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
    .title { min-width: 0; }
    h1 { margin-top: 4px; font: 400 36px/1.04 var(--serif); letter-spacing: .02em; white-space: nowrap; }
    .title p { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--soft); }
    .title p a { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); }
    .tools { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .seg { display: flex; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--panel); }
    .seg span { padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--soft); }
    .seg span.on { background: var(--ground); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; }

    /* the page: what the book says of itself, then its shelf, then the entry that was pressed */
    .thing { grid-area: thing; min-width: 0; padding: 6px 32px 40px; overflow: auto; }
    .says { max-width: 56ch; margin-bottom: 28px; font: 400 20px/1.5 var(--serif); color: var(--ink); }
    .shelf { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 34px; }
    .book p { margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .book small { color: var(--soft); font-size: 12px; }

    /* a cover: the book's face, as 1 draws it, in the book's hue with 1's gradient. The foot names who it is by.
       The book that catalogues itself is the first on the shelf, in the site's own blue-black, because it is the site. */
    .cover { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; padding: 13px 12px 11px 16px; border-radius: 4px 7px 7px 4px; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c, #14323c) 90%, white), color-mix(in srgb, var(--c, #0c1b1f) 86%, black)); box-shadow: inset 5px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .28), inset 6px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), 0 10px 20px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); }
    .cover b { font: 600 15px/1.12 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.005em; }
    .cover i { margin-top: auto; font: 500 9.5px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-style: normal; opacity: .85; }
    .cover::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 12px; top: 56%; height: 1px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .35); }
    .cover.self { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #16303a, #0c1b1f); }

    /* the entry pressed in the side bar, open under the shelf: the cover large, what the book is about, and the way in */
    .entry { display: flex; gap: 26px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 22px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; }
    .entry .cover { flex: none; width: 150px; padding: 18px 14px 12px 22px; }
    .entry .cover b { font-size: 22px; }
    .entry .words { min-width: 0; }
    .entry em { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--sans); font-style: normal; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--soft); }
    .entry em i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dot); }
    .entry h2 { margin: 6px 0 8px; font: 400 26px/1.1 var(--serif); letter-spacing: .02em; }
    .entry .says { margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 18px; }
    .entry .counts { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--soft); }
    .entry .counts b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
    .read { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--ground); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

    /* on a phone: the bar stays at the top, what the page holds becomes a row of pills under its name, the shelf three across */
    @media (max-width: 760px) {
        body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: auto; height: auto; min-height: 100%; }
        .lib { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 4; height: 50px; margin-right: 54px; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; gap: 4px; overflow: auto hidden; scrollbar-width: none; }
        .logo { margin-right: 8px; }
        .logo b { font-size: 19px; }
        .find, .me b { display: none; }

Four Schemes
×
Concept 33, an idea, after the restraint of the coming-soon page, with none of its effects; its comparables the hues each genre wears on the web — documentation indigo, reading sepia, design rose — and Matter's dark themes, which carry a hint of the reader's own palette.
A colour scheme for each book, each a set of roles and nothing else: a deep ground that is never pure black and has an undertone of its own; words in an off-white of the opposite temperature; one hue, read as a dot and as a hairline; a paper and an ink to read on. Each is shown as it works — the library's bar with the book lit, the book's contents, its page, its cover. The library's is the site's own. The story's, the manual's and the design book's are first proposals.
Where it is: built as the theme's roles, five of which a book sets, the frame of 15 read from them by the tone.

The Portfolio
What this book keeps for itself
This book is a portfolio, the type of book that records how a library came to look the way it does, and its book file says that in one line. What a portfolio is made of stands in the reference manual so that another can be made the same way: the type of book and its look, the Exhibition, in The Portfolio; the vocabulary its chapters are written in, The Paragraphs and The Concept; the views its parts are read in, The Gallery and The Room; and its two tools, The Camera and The Print.
What is only this book's is beside its chapters: its cover, with the blueprint scheme the Exhibition paints from and the window its mark is cut through; every concept's page with its three photographs; the three pages designed from prints; and the chapters themselves, which are mine. Its book file is one line, that this book is a portfolio, and that is the whole of its code.
